cohort: The study included 441 pregnant patients affected by intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy who delivered 484 neonates in a 4-hospital system over a 30-month period.
finding: Preterm deliveries in patients with bile acid levels >10 mmol/L were associated with higher rates of neonatal intensive care unit admission and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to early-term deliveries.
gest_age: The study included neonates delivered at late preterm, early-term, and term gestational ages, specifically examining deliveries between 36 and 39 weeks gestation.
